topic: Buy now pay later stacking vs using one debit card (Troy vs Leah)

scenes.narration: Eight Klarna purchases dropped his credit score ninety points. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a phone with eight Klarna icons floating around it, comic burst banner reads NINETY POINT DROP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Troy and Leah both want fall clothes, headset, sneakers, and watch.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man troy and woman leah on phones with the same four item shopping cart, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both have around four hundred dollars a month to spend.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, both troy and leah holding envelopes stamped FOUR HUNDRED MONTHLY BUDGET, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Troy splits every purchase into four payments using Klarna and Afterpay.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, troy on a phone with checkout screens showing KLARNA FOUR PAYMENTS and AFTERPAY FOUR PAYMENTS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He has eight active buy now pay later plans running together.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, troy on a phone with eight active payment plans listed on screen, comic banner reads ONLY FORTY A WEEK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leah waits a week then picks only two items she actually needs.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, leah at a desk with two items in a small online cart, a notepad reading WAIT ONE WEEK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She pays with debit in full and skips the headset and watch.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, leah holding a debit card with a checkout screen stamped PAID IN FULL, two items crossed out, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two months later all of Troy's plans report to credit bureaus.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, three credit bureau logos lit up with red alerts pointing at troy's eight plans, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His score drops ninety points overnight from the new reporting.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked troy at a kitchen table looking at a falling credit score chart, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His real monthly payments add up to three hundred twenty dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, calendar with eight payment dates highlighted, comic banner reads THREE TWENTY A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leah owes nothing. Her score is unchanged. Bank balance untouched.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, leah wearing her sneakers at a desk with a clean bank balance on screen and a steady score chart behind her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wait a week. Pay in full on debit. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle, holding a clipboard reading WAIT A WEEK PAY IN FULL, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
